claim: QA 12a R1, wave 5: which rows can run low is v_low_stock_items' answer alone, so every below-par count says the inbox's number, foods included. common/stock-status.ts copies none of the view's row tests (canRunLow is gone; no master_wine_id, inventory_state, IN_TRANSIT, deleted_at or is_active test in its code): bandOfRow calls a below-par row not_alerted unless the view's ids hold it, so alertBandOfViewRow keeps a beer or flour the view holds, and summarizeStock throws LowStockListUnreadError when a read is missing instead of counting 0 low. On /inventory the Below par chip and the read sentence count belowParAlerted (below on the shelf AND in the view's ids); with the list unread the chip is the disabled dash and the sentence says so. Specs: low-stock-reads-agree.spec.ts 'below par, one count'; dashboard-and-inventory-count-one-way and an-uncounted-wine-is-not-low-stock (unread view refuses); InventoryNext.test.tsx two Below par cases. Source text only.
